name: Crusher
summary: +1 Str or Con; Bludgeoning hits shove foes 5 feet, and Bludgeoning Critical Hits grant Advantage against the target.

benefits.name: Push
benefits.summary: Once per turn, a Bludgeoning hit can move the target 5 feet if it is at most one size larger than you.
benefits.text: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space, provided the target is no more than one size larger than you.

benefits.name: Enhanced Critical
benefits.summary: After a Bludgeoning Critical Hit, attack rolls against that creature have Advantage until your next turn.
benefits.text: When you score a Critical Hit that deals Bludgeoning damage to a creature, attack rolls against that creature have Advantage until the start of your next turn.
